title: Capability Token
description: Offline capability token that authorizes child agent actions

allowed_knowledge.description: Knowledge base IDs the agent may access

allowed_tools.description: Tool IDs the agent may invoke

denied_tools.description: Tool IDs explicitly denied (deny takes precedence)

offline_expiry.description: When offline capability expires (must re-sync before)

max_offline_actions.description: Maximum number of actions allowed offline

policy_hash.description: Hash of the policy version this capability is bound to

issuer_signature.description: ML-DSA-65 signature from the Mother Agent over the capability payload
